subject: Myth & Symbolism
subcategory: The World Tree and Cosmic Maps
title: The Medicine Wheel

hook.text: The medicine wheel in Native American traditions maps the four directions with colors, seasons, and life stages.

buildup.text: East is spring and birth. South is summer and youth. West is autumn and adulthood. North is winter and wisdom.

discovery.text: The wheel maps a complete life lived in balance. Moving through all four is the path to wholeness.

twist.text: The medicine wheel is a mandala and a compass. It's both spatial and temporal—geography and biography merged.

climax.text: Four directions become four seasons become the four stages of life. The wheel says space and time are one.

punchline.text: Walk all four directions. That's a full life.

quiz.question: What does the medicine wheel map?
options: Four directions linked to seasons and life stages
